**Burnout 3: Takedown Widescreen Fix (PCSX2F)** corrects aspect ratio, HUD scaling, and field of view for widescreen displays.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#burnout3) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/Burnout3.PCSX2F.WidescreenFix/main.cpp)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Aspect ratio** — Correct widescreen aspect ratio scaling.
- **HUD** — Correct HUD scaling for widescreen.
- **Field of view** — Adjust the field of view for widescreen.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Use [PCSX2 Fork With Plugins](https://github.com/ASI-Factory/PCSX2-Fork-With-Plugins/releases/tag/latest).
3. Extract the plugin archive into the emulator folder, preserving its `PLUGINS` directory.
4. Set the emulator’s aspect ratio or window size, then launch a supported version of the game.

## Hub settings

Widescreen support is enabled by default and follows the emulator display. Configure it in FusionFixHub or on fusionfix.io; changes apply the next time the emulated game starts. An old fix `.ini` file isn't used anymore and can be deleted. Choose anti-aliasing in PCSX2.

## Known limits

There is no field-of-view multiplier, HUD aspect or size setting, intro skip, or choice of cutscene borders and movie framing. Split-screen layouts have not been checked across every aspect ratio.

## Presets and FusionFixHub

- All three presets keep widescreen support on.
- Setting texts: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
